verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single Paddle.js checkout (inline or overlay) and one local payment method, Pix with recurring Pix Automático mandates for Brazil, that is turned on and set up inside that same checkout. That supports the idea of adding local methods without a separate integration, but only for one method. missing for 10: any evidence of Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL support, a documented list of supported payment methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
